rationale: The focused proposal explicitly preserves retained feature/proof support and historical path handling at the base revision. New flat-name rejection and explicit missing Release-alias suppression change that behavior independently of the actual nested Release move.

Direct synthetic reproduction using unchanged validate_changed_spec accepts complete valid docs/design/release.md, docs/design/skill.md and docs/design/authoring.md documents. New validate_documents rejects all three with BFR-MODEL-PATH. An arbitrary valid docs/design/arbitrary.md continues to pass both, confirming a newly selected-name restriction rather than existing generic grammar.

Actual python scripts/select-validation.py --mode explicit --path docs/design/release.md selects model.validate with that absent path. Base catalog_command instead resolves the historical flat Release alias to the declared owner. The actual moved source docs/design/engineering/release.md is a separate identity and can retain strict explicit-missing behavior without removing the older alias.

Focused native execution passes: 10 admission tests, 25 Skill resource/Design/policy tests, and 34 Release preparation/profile tests. These results do not erase the scope defect; the new old-owner negative test currently encodes the incompatible expectation.
